lines.say: first spine fractures fell from 4.3% to 1.9% in women with osteoporosis (it's a SERM)
invasive breast cancer fell 44% to 71% versus placebo after menopause
LH and FSH rose over 3 months in 30 older men (small trial; off-label)
testosterone rose in one small trial of older men, not in another (not advised for men)
PSA rose about 17% over 3 months in 30 older men (small trial)
triglycerides checked in women whose levels rose on estrogen
blood clots in the legs or lungs, most likely in the first 4 months (boxed warning)
death from stroke in women with heart disease or high heart risk (boxed warning)
